notes.title: ⏱41 Hours Available Now!
notes.content:
Hi!
This game is an epic action adventure that is also a love story.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=wWDl5nULCXE

We're absolutely delighted to announce 41 HOURS (Full version) is now available on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1358020/41_Hours/
It has been 6 years since we have started work on 41 Hours. It has been a lot of fun developing this game from start to finish and we are all proud of the game we have developed.

Thank you to everyone who played The Prologue. The community helped us find bugs and helped to improve the final game.

Interesting facts:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38244014/46f2de143f3da86fa9cc83cb77e62fa907f32173.gif
The main character, Ethan Moore, a scientist who studied the blackhole formations and space-time continuum distortions in order to achieve time travel. He has the conviction that with every decision we make, with every event in this Universe, there is an infinity of possibilities which develop all in parallel. We navigate our lives on a single thread but wormholes could enable travel amongst the different threads.
  
He has a terrible work-life balance, at the expense of his family life. His wife, Clara, was living almost alone during the absence of her husband, who was spending most of his time in the laboratory amongst other scientists. One day, when they were supposed to be celebrating their wedding anniversary, Clara calls Ethan to remind him about the event, and the fact that she’s cooking something special for the dinner at 20:00. Business as usual for our main character, he forgets all about the dinner being immersed into an experiment. When he remembers about it it’s already past 1AM, his phone, discharged, has tens of missed phone calls. Ethan rushes home, thinking how could Clara ever forgive him. In the meantime, Clara cried herself asleep while the cooking stove was on, setting the house on fire...

Ethan cannot believe how events unravel under his eyes, and he reaches home just to find policemen, firmen and ambulances everywhere, letting him know that there were no survivors.

This is how it starts...
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38244014/a812b8c09709a7576058b231f489b2595317ba17.gif

Thank you all for coming on this journey with us!
Cheers
Valkyrie Initiative, Texelworks
Don't forget to join us on the official Discord!

notes.title: Improvements based on your feedback
notes.content:
Changelog:

 Performance optimizations
 The candidate can now jump higher
 The world gravity was increased so the telekinesis is easier to use
 FPC push force is now greatly reduced so the player will move much harder by mistake the objects manipulated with telekinesis
 Solved a bug in the character customization
 Walking over the electromagnetic fields now return a message so the players can understand what is the purpose of it
 Reduced the number of animals in both maps
 Reduced the volume of the sounds produced by the animals and also the distance they can be heard from
 Manipulatin the explosive barrels is now safer because we ve uncreased the speed at which the barrels explode while manupilated with telekinesis
 Changed the mapping for Cycling through attachements from left right bracket to X and C

notes.title: ⚡️Prologue Out Now! - Try 41 HOURS on Steam⚡️
notes.content:
Everyone!
[previewyoutube=wWDl5nULCXE;full][/previewyoutube]
Big news: the Prologue to 41 Hours is available now!

If you're a big fan of FPS Action games you will like what we have!
Prologue to 41 Hours is a first-person shooter dramatic experience that follows the narrative of Ethan, a workaholic scientist in search of his long-lost wife. This is a one-hour prologue of the incredible, action-packed journey.

 Multiverse Theory
 Portals
 Puzzles
 Robots and alien-manipulated zombies.
 Super-human abilities
 Time manipulation 
 Realistic guns and more

We decided to make our demo permanently available to download and play, and we hope this will give everyone the chance to try out the game and get a feel for what it is like, so… give us your thoughts about it, will ya?!😉

Cheers
Valkyrie Initiative
